card.line: Tiberias was a city beside the Sea of Galilee, built by Herod Antipas and named for the emperor Tiberius. Boats from there show up in John's story of the crowd.

moments.title: Boats from Tiberias
moments.text: After Jesus gave thanks and fed the people with bread, some boats from Tiberias landed near that spot. The crowd then got into boats and went to Capernaum to look for Jesus.
